meta.title: Dr R N Daga - Urologist & Andrologist in Jaipur | RNMH
meta.description: Consult Dr R N Daga, Urologist & Andrologist at R N Multispeciality Hospital Jaipur. 20+ years of experience. Book an appointment today.

biography: Dr Ram Naresh Daga specialises in minimally invasive and laser urological surgery, including treatment for kidney stones, prostate enlargement and urological cancers (URS, PCNL, TURP, TURBT). A former Assistant Professor of General Surgery, he has handled well over a thousand such cases and takes care to choose the least invasive option.
clinicalPhilosophy: Every patient deserves compassionate care, clear communication, and the most effective, least invasive treatment plan available.

faqs.answer: You can book an appointment with Dr R N Daga by calling our reception or messaging us directly on WhatsApp via this page.
